set.body: Define the minimal shared lifecycle algebra with associated Program, Compiled, FitPayload, Application and Candidate types; typed program, data, result and scope bindings; declared to compiled to fitted transitions; and capability-based post-fit operations. Adapt exact spectral OperatorProgram and OperatorFitBundle without behavior change. Acceptance: mismatched family stages cannot compile; fitted values are constructible only from a bound execution receipt; spectral laws and source compatibility pass on JVM and Scala.js; no GLRM-specific branches enter the kernel.
set.title: Introduce the family-indexed model lifecycle kernel and spectral adapter
